model_family: Trackastra-motivated linear temporal association ranker diagnostic

literature_evidence.citation: Gallusser B, Weigert M. Trackastra: Transformer-based cell tracking for live-cell microscopy. ECCV 2024.
literature_evidence.reported_result: Temporal context and explicit competition among parent candidates materially improve cell-association prediction.
literature_evidence.task_relevance: The repository's temporal ranker is a deliberately small diagnostic of the same context-and-competition mechanism; this run tests whether its proposal-level gain survives exact graph realization.

hypothesis.observed_failure_mode: The 6bba temporal ranker passed proposal-level OOF precision and utility gates but regressed by 0.001408 on frozen CV57 after graph application.
hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Require every learned association successor to beat the exact banked APNCC control after held-fit graph reconstruction and official scoring, not only on labeled proposal utility.
hypothesis.falsification_test: Reproduce the fixed five-fold 6bba temporal ranker with each held fold excluded from fitting and threshold selection, reconstruct candidate and APNCC graphs for all 69 held-fit videos, and verify that the preregistered +0.005 graph gate PARKs the already-known CV57 failure.

early_stop_conditions: Stop on any memory, free-memory, swap, artifact-identity, or scope violation.
Stop if validation12 or CV57 would be loaded.
Stop if any held video enters its model fit, normalization, or threshold selection.
Stop if the deterministic proposal-level OOF metrics do not reproduce the source report.
success_criteria: All 69 eligible 6bba train105 videos receive exactly one held-fold prediction.
The APNCC control is reconstructed from the hash-pinned banked runtime contract.
Candidate and control fragments score through the attested official scorer.
The graph gate returns PARK for the temporal ranker known to regress on CV57.
No result from this retrospective diagnostic authorizes promotion or CV57.

decision_basis: PASS authorizes only a guarded deterministic fit-only reproduction needed to validate the surrogate-to-graph gate. The locked 3.5% field is the minimum improvement demanded of a future promotable successor, not a renewed claim for the already-PARKed temporal ranker. No holdout, Kaggle, GPU, RunPod, or promotion action is authorized.
